title: Structura Reditus Research Library — Source Record
description: A source object. External work remains an external source object with preserved authorship, source-native claims, source identity, and missingness. A source is never rewritten into a local interpretation.

source_type.description: external: work outside Structura Reditus; corpus-native: work inside the SR corpus; dataset: a dataset source; historical: a historical document source.

source_authors.description: Original authorship exactly as attributable. Never replaced by a library AuthorID for external work.

source_native_claims.description: Claims the source itself makes, in the source's own terms. Local interpretation is never placed here.

identifier.description: External identity of the source (DOI, URL, ISBN, archive reference). Only supplied values; never guessed.

publication_year.description: Publication year if known; null preserves missingness.

links.description: Labeled outbound resources. The original work stays on its DOI/archive platform; the library never mirrors it. At most one link per source may be preferred. Link failure never deletes a source; DOI identity survives a broken web link. Full-text, code, data, and supplement URLs are never guessed.

missingness.description: Explicit list of unavailable metadata or evidence. Preserved, never silently filled.

version.description: Version or edition of the named work exactly as the source states it (e.g. '2.0', 'v2.1.5'). Null when the source states none.

status.description: active: current source state for this named work; superseded: a later source record (superseded_by) is the current state; historical: prefreeze/lineage witness kept as evidence.

concept_doi.description: Archive concept DOI that resolves to the latest deposited version (e.g. a Zenodo concept DOI). Source identity != archive concept != deposited version.

version_doi.description: DOI of the specific deposited version this record refers to.

related_dois.description: Other DOIs observed for this work, each typed. Preserves lineage without collapsing concept, version, or alternate records into one identifier.

supersedes.description: Earlier source records (SRC-*) whose state this record supersedes; the earlier records are preserved.
